classification.rationale: Public podcast transcript covering missing scientists, UFO disclosure, and advanced research programs. Contains speculative, extraordinary claims about sensitive topics. No classification marks, but the content's nature warrants caution.

_raw_list: Retired Air Force General Neil McCassland vanished from his home in Albuquerque, NM, on February 27, 2026, around midday.
He left behind his prescription glasses, phone (switched off), smartwatch, but took a red backpack, wallet, and a .38 caliber revolver.
His wife Susan returned home at 12:04 PM to find him missing and reported him missing at 3:07 PM.
Susan told police he had been dealing with anxiety, lack of sleep, and short-term memory problems, but a week earlier he cycled 60 miles and was not disoriented.
Despite extensive searches by multiple agencies (FBI, Air Force OSI, mountain rescue, drones, dogs), no trace of him was found, and no surveillance footage identified his direction.
McCassland once commanded the Air Force Research Laboratory (AFRL) at Wright-Patterson AFB, a site long linked to Roswell debris and exotic materials research.
From 2011-2013 he ran AFRL; from 2009-2011 he was Director of Special Programs at the Pentagon, overseeing acquisition special access programs (the 'motherlode' of black projects).
Wikileaks in 2016 released emails showing Tom Delong discussing McCassland's involvement in UFO disclosure efforts and describing him as 'very aware' of the projects.
Susan McCassland acknowledged that Neil had contact with Delong, though less after the leak, and a calendar invite shows she accepted a meeting with Delong and Podesta.
Trump announced on Truth Social on February 19, 2026, that he was directing agencies to release UAP-related files; McCassland vanished eight days later.
After retirement, McCassland founded DBE Consulting with James Technelia, former deputy of DARPA and director of DTRA, an agency also linked to intelligence on extraterrestrials.
